tasks.label: kill-schedio
tasks.command: Stop-Process -Name 'schedio' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'schedio stopped (or was not running)'

tasks.label: deploy: start k8s cluster and verify
tasks.command: wsl -d Kubernetes -- sudo dbus-launch true ; kubectl cluster-info ; kubectl apply -f ./deploy/secrets/pull-secret.yaml

tasks.label: deploy: helm upgrade --install schedio
tasks.command: wsl -d Kubernetes -- sudo dbus-launch true ; helm upgrade --install schedio ./deploy/helm/schedio --set 'imagePullSecrets[0].name=ghcr-secret' --set hostNetwork=true --wait

tasks.label: deploy: helm uninstall schedio
tasks.command: wsl -d Kubernetes -- sudo dbus-launch true ; helm uninstall schedio --wait
